Name: Puerto Ferro Trail (East)
Description: Starts at the second parking lot on the Puerto Ferro Peninsula and leads to the historic Puerto Ferro Lighthouse. A small side trail provides access to Puerto Ferro Beach.

Name: Puerto Mosquito National Natural Landmark Trail (East)
Description: Triangle hike leading to an observation platform overlooking Puerto Mosquito National Natural Landmark, Puerto Mosquito Bioluminescent Bay, Puerto Ferro Bay, and surrounding areas.

Name: Playuela Trail (East)
Description: Ecotone trail through dry forest and mangrove forest. Habitat for warblers, ducks, shorebirds, and bats. Ends at Playuela Beach.

Name: Cerro Playuela Trail (East)
Description: Climbs from mangrove forest into dry forest. Scenic overlooks include Corcho Beach, Caribbean Sea cliffs, and Playuela Beach.

Name: Tapon Trail (East)
Description: Mangrove forest trail connecting to Caracas Beach. Excellent birdwatching opportunities including warblers and shorebirds.

Name: El Pobre Trail (West)
Description: Leads through a mangrove forest with endemic and migratory birds and ends at the mouth of Kianí Lagoon.

Name: Berdiales Beach Trail
Description: Short trail leading to the historic Puerto Ferro Lighthouse with nearby access to Puerto Ferro Beach.

Name: Puerto Mosquito NNL Observation Deck Trail
Description: Short trail to the historic lighthouse.

Name: Puerto Mosquito NNL Trail
Description: Trail leading to the observation deck.
